label: Realistically, what job do you see yourself doing in 10 years time? What job do you expect to have? (OUG 1980) - at age 36 years
meta_rows: Realistically, what job do you see yourself doing in 10 years time? What job do you expect to have? (OUG 1980) - at age 36 years
Only asked if not looking for work and not working. This uses OUG codes from the Classification of Occupations 1970. There are also codes from Classification of Occupations 1980
cat_rows: This category contains data on the employment history which includes voluntary work and retirement. Details captured included, number of hours works , overtime, manegerial duties,  occupational codes. Similar information is available for the spouse. Questions were asked in 1982 (age 36 years), 1989 (age 43 years), 1999 (age 53 years), 2006-10 (age 60-64 years), 2014 (age 68 years), 2015 (age 69 years), 2022 (age 76 years) and 2025 (age 79 years).
